column2: Peel the carrots and cut into sticks; cut the cucumber into sticks too. Put the hummus in a small bowl and eat the vegetable sticks with it.

Slice the potatoes and dice the onion. Heat olive oil in a pan and fry the potatoes for 8–10 min until golden. Add the onion and fry for 3 min, then season with salt, pepper and paprika. Eat the cottage cheese cold on the side or briefly stir it in.

Peel and dice the potatoes and boil for 15 min or roast in the oven. Fry the mince in a pan with a little oil until crumbly and brown. Add the pepper in pieces and fry for 5 min. Season with salt, pepper and paprika and mix with the potatoes.
